lab_questions.title: Lab 1: C - EASY - DEBUGGING
lab_questions.description: This is a easy DEBUGGING lab about C for the INSURANCE domain.

tasks.title: Identify the root cause of the crash in the insurance module
tasks.description: A recent deployment caused the insurance service to crash under heavy load. Read the provided logs and identify the C codebase regression.

tasks.title: Fix the C exception
tasks.description: Patch the identified regression in the C service to ensure robust exception handling.

tasks.title: Add regression tests
tasks.description: Write a unit test to verify that the bug is fully resolved and will not recur.
